sections.title: 1. Redundant Computations (Highest Priority)
2. Unnecessary Re-renders
3. Multiple Passes Over the Same Array (`reportBuilder.ts`)
4. No N+1 Patterns Found
sections.content:
This is a local state app with no async queries per list item — no N+1 concerns in the traditional sense.

---

sections.title: 5. Memory Leak Risk
Summary Table
sections.content:
| Issue | File | Impact | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unmemorized analytics | `LogScreen.tsx` | High — fires on search keystrokes | `useMemo` all 5 computed values |
| Repeated `logs` iteration | `DashboardScreen.tsx` | High — 7+ passes per render | `useMemo` block |
| `FlatList` item re-renders | `TrainingLogCard.tsx` | Medium — scales with log count | `React.memo` + `useCallback` |
| 6 sequential `setState` calls | `TrainingLogForm.tsx` | Medium — 6 renders per edit open | Single state object |
| `notesWarning` on every keystroke | `TrainingLogForm.tsx` | Low | `useMemo` |
